newsitem.title: USA: USX-U.S. Steel Group Q1 net rises.
newsitem.headline: USX-U.S. Steel Group Q1 net rises.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE - Per share amounts after preferred dividends.
1997 Q1 First Call consensus analysts' earnings per share estimate was $0.70.

1997 net includes a credit to interest expense relating to the carrying value of indexed debt and net unfavorable environmental accrual adjustments, which had a net favorable estimated aftertax effect of $5 million. The environmental accrual included charges of $20 million to implement new accounting for environmental remediation liabilities partially offset by $11 million reduction in other environmental accruals.
1997 operating income included $15 million received as partial recovery of insurance proceeds related to the April 1996 breakout of Gary Works' No 13 blast furnace.
